key_difference: (D) has the same design as (B): a static reload() forwards to a private method that invalidates m_lastCheck under the mutex, and qmime_secondsBetweenChecks is no longer exported. The only differences are cosmetic: the private method is named requestReload(), the constant stays an int rather than becoming a std::chrono 5s, and there is a redundant null check on QMimeDatabasePrivate::instance().
